plates.side_label: TORN NEWSPAPER PROOFS VS 10¹⁰× TIDAL GAP

plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked four-line 'torn newspaper' proof diagram shows (1) the 200-metre continental shelf fit between Brazil and West Africa, (2) Appalachian and Caledonian mountain alignment, (3) freshwater Mesosaurus and Glossopteris fossil bands across 5,000 km, and (4) Harold Jeffreys's 1924 calculation that tidal forces are 10¹⁰× too weak to plough granite through solid basalt.
